description: This file contains utility functions for checking data types and shapes related to scatter and gather operations in the ATen tensor library used within the PyTorch project. It includes functions for type validation and shape validation for tensors involved in scatter/gather operations.

methods.name: void scatter_gather_dtype_check(const std::string & method_name,const Tensor & self,const Tensor & index,const std::optional<Tensor> & src_opt=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Checks whether the index tensor has dtype int64 or int32 and validates that self and src tensors have matching data types if src is provided.

methods.name: void gather_shape_check(const Tensor & self,int64_t dim,const Tensor & index)
methods.description: Checks the shape compatibility for gather-like operations, ensuring index dimensions match with self and are within bounds.

methods.name: void scatter_shape_check(const Tensor & self,int64_t dim,const Tensor & index,const std::optional<Tensor> & src_opt=std::nullopt)
methods.description: Validates shape constraints for scatter-like operations, including size relations between self, index, and optional src tensors.

ctags.name: gather_shape_check
ctags.pattern: /^inline void gather_shape_check(const Tensor& self, int64_t dim,$/

ctags.name: scatter_gather_dtype_check
ctags.signature: (const std::string & method_name,const Tensor & self,const Tensor & index,const std::optional<Tensor> & src_opt=std::nullopt)

ctags.name: scatter_shape_check
ctags.signature: (const Tensor & self,int64_t dim,const Tensor & index,const std::optional<Tensor> & src_opt=std::nullopt)
